newsitem.title: FRANCE: Pechiney says Carbone sale not imminent.
newsitem.headline: Pechiney says Carbone sale not imminent.

text.p: Pechiney said on Wednesday it had no immediate plans to sell its 40 percent stake in Carbone Lorraine although it may eventually withdraw from the capital of the carbon products company.
"There is nothing new. The group has said it did not plan to stay in (the capital) of Carbone Lorraine over the long-term but this is not imminent," a company spokesman said.
Carbone Lorraine shares rose sharply after French daily La Tribune said Pechiney may soon sell its Carbone Lorraine stake.
Carbone Lorraine shares jumped 7.96 percent to 1,099 francs and Pechiney gained 2.26 percent to 222 francs at 1413 GMT.
